page.title: Kubernetes
page.description: A Kubernetes cluster joins gpuworks as one DaemonSet: every GPU node the DaemonSet selects becomes a node here by itself, and instances run as Pods on their node. Cards are borrowed from Kubernetes while an instance uses them and handed back after the idle period.
page.empty: No Kubernetes cluster yet. Connect one and its GPU nodes show up in the node list.

clusterUid.notEnrolledHint: No node has joined from this cluster yet.

actions.revokeHelp: Nodes already connected keep working. New nodes can no longer join with this command.
actions.deleteHelp: Only the cluster record here is removed. Delete the DaemonSet in Kubernetes yourself. A cluster that still has nodes cannot be deleted.

manifest.title: Manifest of {{name}}
manifest.failed: The manifest could not be loaded

drawer.title: Connect a Kubernetes cluster
drawer.name: Name
drawer.nameRequired: Enter a name for the cluster
drawer.serverUrlHelp: The address the agents in the cluster reach this server at. It must be reachable from the cluster's Pods.
drawer.serverUrlInvalid: Enter an http:// or https:// address
drawer.nodeSelectorHelp: Optional. Comma-separated key=value pairs; only Kubernetes nodes with all of these labels join. Empty means every node.
drawer.namespaceHelp: Where the DaemonSet and its resources are created.
drawer.agentImageHelp: Empty uses the default agent image.
drawer.runtimeClassHelp: The RuntimeClass the agent Pod and instance Pods use to reach the GPUs. Empty means none.
drawer.containerdSocketHelp: Path on the node. k3s uses /run/k3s/containerd/containerd.sock.
drawer.enginePortsHelp: Host ports the inference engines listen on. It must not overlap the cluster's NodePort range (30000-32767 by default).
drawer.idleReturnSeconds: Seconds idle before a card is returned
drawer.idleReturnHelp: A card borrowed from Kubernetes goes back to it after sitting idle for this long.
drawer.keepCardsHelp: Never hand borrowed cards back to Kubernetes.

created.title: Cluster {{name}} is ready
created.note: Run this command in the cluster. The GPU nodes it selects show up in the node list by themselves.
created.secret: The command contains the connect token. Treat it like a password.
